prompt:
Hi, I'm a junior analyst at a cross-border trade consulting firm. My manager asked me to produce a competitive landscape report using our internal platform intelligence tool located at /workspace/online-shopping.py.

The report should cover ALL available product categories our tool knows about, include a head-to-head platform comparison for at least one pair of platforms, and provide category-specific platform recommendations.

Please generate the report as a file named `platform_analysis_report.json` in JSON format. The report must be structured with three sections: a summary of all categories (including which platforms are best for each), a platform comparison section (with at least one pairwise comparison including their ratings), and a final recommendations section organized by product category.

All data in the report must come from actually running the tool — my manager will cross-check the numbers.
